mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months (as measured by FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS declining, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.7% over the past month (as measured by UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month signals a misalignment between labor market strength and consumer demand, indicating an overheating economy that may trigger policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 50% of instances where PAYEMS rises and HOUST falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 205) and active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk and reduced corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 205 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances with PAYEMS rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1450 thousand units over the past month (as measured by HOUST) signals a weakening in the residential sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 205), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals an overheating economy that may trigger aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 205 and INDPRO rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (as indicated by retail sales above 370,000 thousand dollars, RSAFS > 370000), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and the expectation of policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 50% of instances where RSAFS > 370000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
